instrument_timeline.split_rule: configs/instrument_amendment_20261115.json, analysis_notes of v2.1-wording-20261115: submitted < reload means the earlier wording; started >= reload means the new wording; otherwise ambiguous, settled from the option set where possible, else flagged.
instrument_timeline.export_limitation: The export row carries assigned_at_utc (assignments.created), not assignments.started. Without the optional --assignment-started sidecar, assigned_at is used as a lower bound of started: assigned_at >= reload proves the new wording, and answers with assigned_at < reload <= submitted are ambiguous, so ambiguous counts are upper bounds. With the sidecar the registered rule is applied exactly on started.
instrument_timeline.precision_note: Every reload instant is known to the second (fraction kept where the journal gives it), so each boundary is a single instant.
